name: Unified Volumetric Avatar (UVA)
definition: A unified volumetric avatar representation that enables local and independent editing of both geometry and texture while retaining the ability to render novel views and poses. It transforms observation points to a canonical space using a skinning motion field and represents geometry and texture in separate neural fields anchored to a deformable mesh.
summary: Unified Volumetric Avatar is an end-to-end trainable method for dynamic human avatars that enables local geometry and texture editing by anchoring latent codes to a deformable mesh, unlike static or UV-mapped approaches.
